scoring_justification: Full recompute of tight-binding Bethe Lattice model (T1) is infeasible in lightweight checker; verify agent-reported defect energies against paper gold with tolerance and check directional shifts (T2 consistency).

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper reported defect energies and shifts for Si dangling bond and Si-Si bond in Si3N4 and Si3N4:O.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table II and text; confirmed by reference solve.sh
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported numerical values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact paper-reported target defect energies and shifts, verifiable against the original publication.

outputs.description: Defect‑state energies (in eV above the respective valence band top) for the Si dangling bond and Si‑Si bond in pure and alloyed Si₃N₄ and SiO₂.

output_contract.notes: The valence band references Ev_Si3N4 and Ev_SiO2 are obtained from the reference DOS calculations of the pure hosts. Only the Si₃N₄ and SiO₂ defect configurations are in scope; hydrogen‑related clusters are excluded because their tight‑binding parameters for H are not provided in the public paper.
